# 25 years ago your father climbed the mountain and never came back. 
[media]

Now he’s calling for you with updated graphics, smoother interactions, and quality of life upgrades in the Director’s Cut.

Casey’s dark journey begins when she receives a cryptic message from her father, which leads her back to the abandoned trails of Coldblood Mountain, a remote wilderness that has haunted her family for generations.

Stalking her is a terrible power, watching Casey’s every move, and forcing her to make horrific decisions in the hopes of finding her lost father. 

Can you help her solve the clues he left littered behind on the mountain’s cold, uncaring slopes? Or will something else find her first?

[media]
# Updated Meta Quest 3 Visuals and Hand Tracking - Horror you can touch!

Broken Spectre takes advantage of the Quest's immersive hand-tracking controls, bringing unparalleled realism to the game’s gruesome body horror elements.

We’ve updated both the visuals and interactions in this Director’s Cut for a spine-tingling and macabre experience you’ll never forget.

# Unique Eldritch Horror Narrative

Produced by one of the creators of The Blair Witch Project – a landmark of the found-footage horror genre - Broken Spectre is an original eldritch horror experience inspired by the works of John Carpenter and H.P. Lovecraft.
